feed.title: UFO Case Lab
feed.subtitle: Practical guides on UFO Case Lab, organized for fast browsing and comparison.

entry.title: What If the Best UFO Explanation Contradicts the Evidence?
entry.summary: A convincing UFO explanation can fail when reliable timing, position or movement evidence contradicts the proposed cause.

entry.title: Was That Line of UFO Lights Starlink?
entry.summary: Starlink satellites can resemble coordinated UFO formations, but their predicted paths and visibility must match the reported lights.

entry.title: Why Do Some UFO Sightings Remain Unexplained After Investigation?
entry.summary: GEIPAN's classifications distinguish UFO sightings with too little evidence from those that remain unidentified after detailed investigation.

entry.title: When Should a UFO Sighting Stay Unexplained?
entry.summary: AI can compare earlier UFO cases and rank possible explanations, but missing records, weak matches and uncertain evidence can leave a sighting unresolved.

entry.title: Was That UFO an Aircraft, Satellite or Something Else?
entry.summary: AI can compare a UFO sighting with flight paths, satellite passes, astronomical positions and historical weather to test ordinary explanations.

entry.title: Was That UFO Actually an Aircraft?
entry.summary: Historical flight records can reveal whether an aircraft matched a UFO's reported position, movement and timing, but missing tracks leave uncertainty.

entry.title: How Can You Reconstruct a UFO Sighting Accurately?
entry.summary: A UFO sighting timeline can reveal what happened and when, provided uncertain times, viewing directions and recording gaps remain visible.

entry.title: Can UFO Witness Interviews Change What People Remember?
entry.summary: A careful UFO witness interview preserves what people actually saw while reducing leading questions, shared memories and later reinterpretations.

entry.title: How Do You Turn a UFO Report Into Evidence?
entry.summary: A useful UFO investigation starts by preserving witness accounts, checking photographs and reconstructing exactly when and where the sighting occurred.
